messages:
maria: Kickoff — we need a tight, enumerated list of edge cases for generation streaming + truncation + token limits + retries. This will go into PRD acceptance criteria.
noah: +1. Start with user-visible guarantees first.
arjun: Runtime notes: streaming envelope, partial events, final sentinel, truncated flag, retry semantics, idempotency keys.
tess: From SDK/docs POV: we must provide deterministic signals so clients can detect truncated vs complete and optionally resume.
maria: Draft acceptance criteria idea: 1) streaming endpoints emit explicit final event with status complete/truncated; 2) token-limit and truncation errors use 4xx with reason; 3) retries without idempotency must be warned in docs; 4) telemetry for truncations.
noah: Implementation option: per-event JSON with types, e.g. a token event and a final event:```
{"type":"token","text":"..."}
{"type":"done","status":"complete"}
```
arjun: Prefer body-level events for streaming visibility. Headers aren't visible mid-stream. Also add a final event: status can be complete|truncated|cancelled.
ci-bot: pipeline: test/stream-sim queued.
tess: SDK contract: final promise resolves to {"status": "complete"|"truncated", token_count: N, truncated_reason: "model_max_tokens"|"policy"|null} (we'll document field names).
maria: Launch must-haves before GA: explicit done/truncated signal, non-5xx token-limit responses, clear retry/backoff guidance. Nice-to-have: resume-from-prefix API, streaming resume token.
noah: Edge cases to enumerate in PRD: very short responses (<3 tokens), single-token completions, streaming function_call flows, structured JSON streaming where truncation yields invalid JSON, clients expecting a valid JSON document.
arjun: Runtime stance: do NOT mutate model output to make it valid. Emit truncated and let client/SDK decide to close heuristically. We'll provide an opt-in helper in SDK like safeCloseJson.
tess: QA test matrix (short):
- normal stream success
- truncated by model max_tokens
- truncated by tenant global token budget
- network drop, no retry
- client retry with idempotency key
- streaming function_call truncated mid-event
- truncated JSON payload and SDK heuristic behavior
noah: Idempotency: require client-supplied idempotency_key for safe retries on streaming. If missing, retries may duplicate tokens. We'll add an explicit warning.
maria: For streaming retries acceptance: supported only when idempotency_key provided AND request deterministic (sampling disabled). Otherwise request should be rejected with 409 and explanatory header.
arjun: Backoff: recommend exponential backoff with jitter. For 429/503 we should set Retry-After header.
tess: Observability: emit metrics for truncated_responses, truncation_reasons, per-model truncation_rate, retry_success_rate, duplicate_token_events. Add a log field to traces to indicate truncated=true.
noah: API surfaces to add: truncation_handling param: "strict" (default, no mutation), "sdk_safe_close" (allow SDK heuristics), "resume_capable" (reserve state and resume token). Default = strict.
maria: Scope: strict + SDK heuristics for hosted GA. Reserve resume_capable for Dedicated/private GA only. Document this in PRD scope section.
arjun: Follow-ups for RFC: precise streaming envelope, wire-level examples, idempotency header name, partial KV persistence semantics for resume_capable, backpressure behavior.
ci-bot: RFC draft saved: /repo/rfcs/015-streaming-truncation-draft.md
maria: OK folks — I'll convert these into acceptance criteria and owners. Timeline proposal: ship strict signals in 2 sprints, resume-capable as follow-up. Any blockers?
noah: No blockers. I'll own idempotency and metrics work.
tess: I'll draft SDK API and docs with examples and warning copy.
arjun: I'll prototype event envelope and a stream simulator for QA tests.
maria: I'll also add launch checklist: tests, docs, metrics, SLOs, rollback plan. Posting timeline later. :rocket:
